episode.title: I Found UNNATURAL APPLES... And They STARTED To GLOW!

synopsis: A man cuts open an apple to reveal a core filled with intricate, softly glowing metallic gears that slowly turn, completely unlike natural fruit flesh.
narration: Honestly, I thought it was just a really dense core at first, but then I cut it open... and found this. Pretty sure my landlord would have some questions about apples that hum and slowly turn like a clock inside. Never seen anything like it.

shots.prompt: Raw front-camera phone realism. ihsan_maker cuts a crisp red apple in half on a clean white kitchen counter. As the apple halves separate, a core of small, intricate, softly glowing metallic gears, slowly turning, is revealed instead of seeds and natural core. ihsan_maker is wearing a plain black crew-neck t-shirt. Bright kitchen window light.

Raw front-camera phone realism. A macro shot focusing on the metallic gears inside the apple half. The gears emit a faint, warm internal light as ihsan_maker gently prods them with a toothpick, showing their intricate metallic surface. ihsan_maker is wearing a plain black crew-neck t-shirt. Handheld, slightly imperfect framing, natural light.

Raw front-camera phone realism. ihsan_maker holds one apple half close to the camera, the internal gears slowly rotating and casting a soft, pulsing glow onto his fingers and the surrounding kitchen environment. The light from the apple subtly illuminates the scene. ihsan_maker is wearing a plain black crew-neck t-shirt. Calm, curious gaze.

Raw front-camera phone realism. An overhead shot of ihsan_maker rotating the two apple halves together on the white counter. The internal gears briefly align and mesh before continuing their independent, slow rotation within each half. ihsan_maker is wearing a plain black crew-neck t-shirt. The soft glow from the apples is visible.

music: A delicate, shimmering instrumental piece featuring a gentle, repeating arpeggio on a glockenspiel or celeste, combined with a subtle, low-frequency synth hum and faint, intricate clockwork-like ticks. The mood is curious and wondrous, building to a soft, magical resonance before slowly fading out, played quietly under the voice-over.
